svg.aria-label: ScienceSoft Endpoint AI Firewall, shown as a journey: Mask: personal data typed into a prompt is replaced with [PERSON], [EMAIL] and [CREDIT_CARD] before it leaves the device; Pseudonymise: names and emails are swapped for realistic stand-ins; the map stays on the device and the reply is restored to the real names; Block: in Block mode a prompt containing an access key is not sent; the user is told why, and the organisation receives a record of what was detected; Shadow AI: with discovery turned on by IT, traffic to an AI endpoint the firewall does not know yet is recognised as AI and reported to the organisation for review; MCP & Skills: MCP servers and agent skills configured on the laptop are inventoried and rated low, medium or high risk with the reason, for IT; OWASP: sensitive information disclosure (OWASP LLM02) is addressed by masking on the device, and agent skills are tagged with OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 codes; DLP: the firewall inspects prompts, images and tool output, and detects names, financial and health identifiers, secrets and custom patterns in seven languages.
svg.title: ScienceSoft Endpoint AI Firewall
svg.text: On-device protection for every prompt your people send to AI.
